realPositiveSource: scanner-localization-hard-v0.1 development split only (10 immutable, checksum-verified samples)
holdoutPolicy: The four v0.1 holdout images are excluded from all development runs and inspected only once after the detector is frozen.
qualityPolicy: excellent <=0.012 normalized RMSE and <=0.02 worst corner; acceptable <=0.03 RMSE and <=0.05 worst corner; wrong-board >0.06 RMSE or clear non-playable rectangle.
